reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for persistent, locally stored agent memory that automatically recalls relevant project knowledge and injects it into system prompts, with tools and a local viewer for managing memories.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地持久化智能体记忆，自动保存并将相关项目知识注入系统提示词，并支持记忆管理与本地查看。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with persistent local agent memory that stores and recalls project knowledge in system prompts, with tools and a local viewer for memory management.

capabilities: Stores persistent memories locally in YAML
Detects and records corrections, preferences, facts, and turn summaries
Retrieves relevant memories using local search and injects them into the system prompt
Provides memory management tools and a local read-only browser viewer
Sends injected memory content to the configured model provider as part of agent prompts
